checks.name: V1 data and sessions survive V2 upgrade; legacy API digest is initialized privately
legacy PIN reset issues the first usable key; create returns one-time API key
V2 migration is idempotent and preserves key, board, and both session kinds
public records never reveal API key, hash, or sessions; anonymous private access is denied
wrong API key, cross-board key, malformed key, and expired token are rejected
presence requires a valid board-bound session and returns only safe member fields
same nicknames remain separate; offline holders and heartbeat are accurate without project writes
external sessions cannot call legacy save and human writes keep source human
external rate limits serialize concurrent requests and do not consume human PIN budget
presence has an independent budget and cannot exhaust edit-code or external budgets
wrong PIN reset persists failure counts; unsupported rollback headers do not run authorization
key reset invalidates all external sessions and old key while preserving human access and revision
concurrent reset and old-key exchange cannot leave an authorized old-key session behind
session cap bounds holders to fifty; external revoke removes only its own session
forced outer rollback remains a deployment boundary and is reported explicitly

limitation: Real isolated PostgreSQL only. WorkBuddy/PostgREST gateway transaction-commit and forced-rollback configuration require separate deployment verification. No live board was modified.
